instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot shows a couple dancing on a grassy mountain summit. On the left, the man in the red striped shirt (R2) stands in profile wearing brown trousers, raising his right arm high. On the right, the woman in the yellow cardigan (R1) stands in blue jeans, smiling joyfully with her left arm raised to clasp his hand above her head. They are captured mid-dance against a scenic backdrop of rolling blue mountains under an overcast sky with soft, natural lighting.
